other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Jharkhand
Applicant must be a worker registered with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)
Applicant must be suffering from one of the specified serious illnesses (e.g., cancer, heart disease, kidney disease, incurable mental disease, AIDS, etc.)
Benefits are applicable once per disease per beneficiary
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for treatment of specified serious illnesses to registered construction workers, applicable once per disease per beneficiary.
